8.3.3 CanTp_Shutdown
[SWS_CanTp_00211] Definition of API function CanTp_Shutdown ⌈
Service Name
CanTp_Shutdown
Syntax
void CanTp_Shutdown (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0x02
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This function is called to shutdown the CanTp module.
Available via
CanTp.h
⌋
[SWS_CanTp_00202] ⌈The function CanTp_Shutdown shall close all pending trans-
port protocol connections, free all resources and set the CanTp module into the
CANTP_OFF state.⌋
[SWS_CanTp_00200] ⌈The function CanTp_Shutdown shall not raise a notification
about the pending frame transmission or reception.⌋
